sources.title: OCPP 2.0.1 Edition 4 Part 2 Specification with errata 2026-06

assertions.assertion: Protected destination-free GetLog sends DiagnosticsLog or SecurityLog with the caller's requestId, optional retries, retryInterval and time window and a bounded provider remoteLocation the caller never supplies; an Accepted reply with the file name is acceptance only, never proof that a file was uploaded.

A Rejected GetLogResponse, with or without statusInfo, is a protocol rejection: the job never starts an upload, keeps the exact reply and releases the drain; a CALLERROR is likewise a rejection and a reply outside the schema leaves delivery uncertain.

LogStatusNotification advances only the job with its exact requestId; Uploading, Uploaded and the failure statuses UploadFailure, BadMessage, PermissionDenied and NotSupportedOperation decode and resolve the job; the 1.6-only UploadFailed is refused; regressions and late reports are counted, never applied; each status commits before the empty reply.

requestId is mandatory unless a TriggerMessageRequest triggered the report and no upload is ongoing: a non-Idle notification without requestId is refused, and an identity-free Idle is accepted only for a triggered report, settles only a job the station has already answered (a pending or uncertain job is left alone) and still counts as trigger evidence.

A new GetLog while a log is being assembled or uploaded may be answered AcceptedCanceled, which marks the older job cancelled and keeps the new one; the station then reports AcceptedCanceled for the cancelled requestId, which never revives or regresses the cancelled job; a request answered plain Accepted supersedes the older job instead.

The station uploads a single file by HTTP PUT or POST to the bridge-provided destination, appending its reported file name to a trailing-slash location; the bridge binds the destination to the job durably before sending, caps the upload at the station's configured maximum, and refuses a test destination where policy forbids it, a destination of the wrong kind or a cap above the maximum.

A reported Uploaded becomes the uploaded state only if the artifact provider holds a complete file for that job's own destination, and the result then carries the provider-computed SHA-256 and size; otherwise the job is upload_unconfirmed.

The command, its durable job and the diagnostics201 release-drain entry commit in one transaction; a station has one request in flight and a retained requestId cannot be reused; lost replies stay uncertain and are never replayed after restart or reconnect; a deadline only times the job out, later native reports still resolve it, and only resolved jobs release the drain.

The independent simulator station model follows N01 from the specification alone: it answers GetLog Accepted with a file name or Rejected, reports every status with the requestId of its request, reports an identity-free Idle only when triggered without an upload, and shares no code or fixtures with the bridge.

not_covered: SecurityEventNotification and the security-log contents themselves (issue #128)
FTP/FTPS uploads, upload resume and Expect: 100-continue (N01.FR.14 beyond HTTP, N01.FR.22, N01.FR.23); only HTTP PUT and POST are exercised
basic-authorization credentials in upload locations (N01.FR.17); the bridge-provided destination carries none
ExtendedTriggerMessage; 2.0.1 TriggerMessage for LogStatusNotification is evidence only
physical hardware, production artifact storage or OCA certification
execution_status: Pinned-schema corpus tests executed in isolated software verification; the named contract, application, storage, protocol, actual-daemon and simulator evidence files are created with the bridge implementation of #125. Not hardware or OCA certification.
